source: https://www.funetf.co.kr/product/etf/view/KR7069500007 (KODEX 200, 069500, holdings as of 2026-08-20 disclosure) and https://www.funetf.co.kr/product/etf/view/KR7229200001 (KODEX 코스닥150, 229200, holdings as of 2026-08-20 disclosure) — full daily holdings disclosure pages for Samsung Asset Management's index-tracking ETFs, used as a proxy for the official KOSPI200 / KOSDAQ150 index constituent lists (KRX's own data.krx.co.kr constituent-download tool now requires an account login and could not be accessed without creating credentials)
note: This is a close proxy, not the verbatim official KRX list. KODEX 200 tracks KOSPI200 via full replication with minor sampling adjustments, so its ~199 usable equity holdings (1 non-standard-code holding excluded, see below) closely match the 200 official constituents but may differ by a handful of names at the margin (recently added/removed names, or names the fund under/over-weights for tracking-error reasons). KODEX 코스닥150 states it uses full replication of KOSDAQ150, giving 149 usable holdings (1 non-standard-code holding excluded) out of 150. One holding was excluded from each list because it used a non-standard alphanumeric KRX code (not a normal 6-digit ticker) that could not be reliably mapped to a Yahoo-style .KS/.KQ symbol: 삼성에피스홀딩스 (code 0126Z0, from the KOSPI200/KODEX200 list) and 에임드바이오 (code 0009K0, from the KOSDAQ150/KODEX 코스닥150 list). Both indices rebalance quarterly (March/June/September/December, with the semiannual June/December rebalance being the larger one) so this list should be treated as accurate as of the 2026-08-20 ETF disclosure date and due for refresh at least quarterly.
